source.text: 6.4 All Equipment required under an Order must be delivered no later than 31 December 2026. Where the Vendor delivers after that date, a single late-delivery penalty equal to 15% of the invoice value for the delayed delivery shall apply. The Parties agree that this is one penalty for the relevant late delivery, not a recurring or daily amount.
8.2 Where a single Order contains ten (10) or more units, a volume reduction of 2% shall be applied to the Equipment value for that Order.
9.1 The Buyer shall pay each valid and undisputed Invoice within 30 days of the invoice date.
8.1 The agreed unit amount for each Fortinet FortiGate 100F Firewall is PKR 620,000 per unit, and the Vendor’s invoice shall not state a unit amount above that figure.
